set.audit_note: Tier 4: Legistar file 26-285 and HCD Standard Agreement 24-CDBG-10025 confirm a single $600,000 state CDBG planning award ($560,748 activity, $39,252 admin), award Sept 3, 2025, $559,909 Lisa Wise contract through June 30, 2028; the agreement lists the work as one sub award (Solano Housing Feasibility Study) rather than two $300,000 awards, which does not change screening. Agreement Exhibit D requires Davis-Bacon and California Labor Code prevailing wage for construction work. The Aug 27, 2026 workshop and Sept 7, 2026 survey dates were not on this page.

reason: Page and grant agreement match on award amount, non-entitlement status, timeline and prevailing wage.

set.audit_note: Tier 4: Section 14.09.210.030 matches the record (5+ units, 5/10/10 percent thresholds, 80 percent bonus and no density cap near transit or in very low VMT areas for 100 percent affordable, one to five incentives, three stories or 33 feet, childcare bonus). Section 14.09.210.030 was also amended by Ord. 2011 of Feb 10, 2026, and subsection H lets the decision maker raise or lower density up to 25 percent for infill sites under 5 acres. prevailing_wage_trigger false is uncited; a density bonus alone conveys no public funds.

reason: Code text matches on eligibility thresholds, bonus amounts, incentives and covenant term.
